name: moonlight-core
description: Shared backend connection, session state and owned-terminal registry. Every other MoonlightCode extension depends on this one.

moonlight.daemon.path.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the `moonlightd` binary this window should start. Leave empty to use the `MOONLIGHT_DAEMON_BIN` environment variable, then the first `moonlightd` on `PATH`.

Set this when you build the daemon yourself and want the editor to start *your* build rather than the installed one. If the path is set but not executable, no daemon is started — a named daemon is never silently swapped for a different one.

moonlight.daemon.autostart.markdownDescription:
Start `moonlightd` from this window when the backend is unreachable.

Turn this off if you run the daemon yourself — from a terminal, a debugger, or a service manager. The editor keeps talking to whichever daemon is running; it just stops starting one, so your process is not displaced by an autostart on the poll loop.

With this off and no daemon running, sessions are ungoverned: the hooks fail open.
